chips.title: Persona framework seeded
chips.summary: Stackable persona profiles with ordered conflict resolution; plugin renamed to masq; first plain-language profile.

evidence.message: Framework seeded and renamed 2026-08-13; plain-language profile added the same day.

chips.title: v0.2 scopes, presets, doctor, voices
chips.summary: Scopes, presets, doctor, and voice profiles including dean; CI fails the build on host identifiers.

evidence.message: v0.2 landed 2026-08-27 and folded into the 0.2.0 changelog; host-identifier CI check 2026-08-24 (PR #2).

chips.title: Conduct and audience axes
chips.summary: Conduct axis split out of persona prose, audience profile separating assumed knowledge from registers, kind boundary with precedence.

chips.title: Machine-checked behavioral evals
chips.summary: Eval fixtures, live plugin smoke test, machine-checked scoring, two overclaims corrected, hook context-limit bug fixed.

evidence.message: Landed 2026-08-28; the context-limit bug had been silently dropping profiles.

chips.title: Adjudicate 108 eval runs
chips.summary: 108 runs adjudicated with Fisher exact p; only the two transport comparisons are significant. Negative result recorded honestly, frames doc written.

evidence.message: 0.7.0 changelog restates the bound: every profile verdict is a point estimate at n=2-3; an unclear label was added for undecidable runs.

chips.title: 0.7.0 hook launcher and renfaire opener fix
chips.summary: Hooks route through a launcher that delegates to the installed plugin copy, so updates apply without a restart; doctor names the running copy; renfaire varies its openers.

evidence.message: Two commits landed 2026-09-27 and shipped as 0.7.0. Launcher, hook, and v0.2 test files all pass when run directly. One pre-0.7.0 session still needs a single restart.

chips.title: Prepare a real profile host
chips.summary: Choose a real conversation set where a profile should visibly change output, and define the effect size that would count as a demonstration.

evidence.message: Named as the next step by the 2026-09-05 status reassessment.
No commit has touched this since 2026-08-28; the 2026-09-27 work went to plugin update plumbing instead. Still the next open step.

chips.title: Delivery checks in the eval format
chips.summary: Make the fixture format assert that the profile was actually delivered to the model, and extend adjudicated labels past the 45 of 186 run files covered today.

evidence.message: Open items 1 and 2 in the catalog plan: the composition result measured truncation because nothing in the format asked whether input was delivered.

chips.title: Demonstrate or bound the effect
chips.summary: Rerun the evals on the real host with delivery checked; either show a significant effect or document the bound and trim profiles that do nothing measurable.

evidence.message: Exit for the milestone; outcome may be a documented bound rather than a positive effect.

chips.title: Reviewer conduct profile
chips.summary: First queued catalog addition: an adversarial working posture that tries to refute findings and names the disconfirming test not run. Gated on a demonstrated profile effect.

evidence.message: Queue item 1 in the catalog plan; its prerequisite (conduct precedence in the runtime contract) is already in place.

chips.title: 0.3 composition controls
chips.summary: Exclusive groups for profiles that should not coexist, conflict metadata and diagnostics, and named compositions. Roadmap gates this on core behavior proven in real sessions.

evidence.message: Roadmap 0.3 minus the kind axis, which already shipped. Order after the catalog work is a guess.
